## Professional Summary

Web and SaaS developer building websites, SaaS products and MVPs with AI in the loop — full-stack,
design through deployment. Nine years of production software: roughly four years hands-on
engineering (Java/JEE, Spring, Node.js, TypeScript, Angular, iOS) and five leading delivery for
distributed enterprise teams across telecom, automotive, life sciences and retail.

The differentiator is the pairing: AI in the build loop is what compresses timelines from months to
weeks, while nine years inside enterprise codebases and delivery programmes is what keeps the
architecture, tests and data model sound enough to survive real users. Certified in Scrum and SAFe.

## Services

- **Websites that rank and convert** — marketing sites, landing pages and portfolios designed and
  built from scratch, not templated. Ships with the SEO foundation most sites bolt on too late:
  structured data, clean semantics, real meta, sitemap, and Core Web Vitals as a requirement.
- **SaaS & MVP builds** — the smallest version that proves the idea: auth, data model, core flows,
  payments if needed, deployed on infrastructure that won't need replacing when it works.
- **Architecture & technical rescue** — for products that shipped fast and now can't move. Codebase
  audit, a plainly-stated view of what's worth saving, a sequenced refactor plan, or the work itself.
- **AI-augmented automation** — LLM workflows, agents, retrieval over internal documents, and
  integrations between systems that don't talk, measured against the pre-automation baseline.

## How Engagements Run

1. **Scope** (free, ~1 week) — a call, then a written scope: what gets built, what doesn't, cost, and
   the date it lands. Includes an honest "I'm not the right fit" if that's the answer.
2. **Build** (2 to 6 weeks typical) — a working link from week one, weekly demo, direct access, and an
   architecture review at the end of each week.
3. **Ship** (days) — live on the client's own infrastructure, domain and accounts, with performance,
   accessibility and SEO verified before launch.
4. **Hand over** (included) — repo, pipeline, documentation and a walkthrough. The client can take it
   to any developer afterwards.

Fixed scope. Fixed price. A date in writing. Code ownership transfers to the client from day one.

## Proof and Current Status

There are no client case studies for this offer yet — that is stated plainly rather than papered over
with borrowed credibility. What is verifiable instead:

- **PawPawCare** — https://pawpawcare.app/ — a pet health tracker (iOS and Android) that Ahmed
  founded and built end to end: vaccine and medication reminders, weight trends, vet record storage,
  AI-powered scanning of vaccination cards and prescriptions, shareable vet and caretaker links.
  Live with real users; the closest thing to a case study for this offer.
- **FitPal** — https://fitpal.ma/ — a white-label member app for gyms (PWA on iOS, Android and web):
  passkey sign-in, owner-approved access requests, group class timetable, workout and body-weight
  tracking, owner dashboard. Built on the open-source openGym core (AGPL), extended by Ahmed with
  access requests, group sessions, a test-gated CI/CD pipeline and a bilingual FR/EN marketing site.
  Live at its first club, FIT'ONE CLUB FITNESS.
- **ahmedchioua.com** — designed, built and deployed by Ahmed. React with hand-written CSS, no
  template or page builder. Scores 100/100/100 on Lighthouse for accessibility, best practices and
  SEO (mobile, measured 2026-08-22).
- **Public source** — https://github.com/r0b0t007/ahmed-portfolio
- **Track record** — nine years of production software for Bell, BMW, Bayer and Harman clients,
  verifiable on LinkedIn, with matching certifications.

The first few client projects go out at founding rates in exchange for a case study and a reference.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does Ahmed Chioua build?
Marketing websites, SaaS products and MVPs, internal tools, and the AI automation behind them.
Full-stack — design through deployment. If it runs in a browser and needs to work properly, it's in
scope.

### How fast is "fast"?
A marketing site is typically 2 to 3 weeks; an MVP typically 4 to 6, depending on scope. The date is
fixed in the written scope before the client commits, and there's a working link from week one.
Building with AI in the loop is what makes those timelines real rather than optimistic.

### Does building with AI mean lower quality?
The opposite of how it's usually assumed to work. AI accelerates the typing — scaffolding,
boilerplate, tests, first drafts. It does not make the architectural decisions, and it does not
review its own result. That's what nine years of enterprise delivery is for. This site is built that
way; Lighthouse confirms it.

### Can I see client work?
Not client work. Nine years were spent building inside enterprise programmes under NDA, and the
independent client side is being built deliberately. What is visible is Ahmed's own shipped products,
PawPawCare (https://pawpawcare.app/) and FitPal (https://fitpal.ma/), plus this site with its source published. That's also why the first few projects go out at founding rates.

### What does it cost?
Fixed price per project, quoted in the free scope call, based on what's actually needed rather than
hours logged. No retainers that can't be exited, no unexpected invoices. Founding-client rates apply
to the next few projects.

### Who owns the code?
The client — outright, from day one. Their repo, their infrastructure, their accounts. Handover
includes documentation and a walkthrough specifically so the work can go to any other developer.

### Does Ahmed work with existing codebases and teams?
Yes. Audits, refactors and rescues are a service in their own right, and five years as a Scrum Master
across distributed enterprise teams makes joining someone else's process familiar rather than
friction.

### Where is Ahmed based, and does it matter?
Tetouan, Morocco (GMT+1), remote-first — which is how the last five years of work with Canadian and
German teams have run. Overlap with Europe is complete and with US Eastern is most of the working day.
